NEC_THRESHOLD.title: 1099-NEC $2,000 threshold
NEC_THRESHOLD.text: Payments of $2,000 or more in TY2026 to a non-employee for services in the course of your trade or business are reported on Form 1099-NEC, box 1 (raised from $600 for payments made after Dec 31, 2025).

MISC_RENT_THRESHOLD.title: 1099-MISC rents $2,000 threshold
MISC_RENT_THRESHOLD.text: Rent payments of $2,000 or more in TY2026 are reported on Form 1099-MISC, box 1. Rent paid to a real estate agent or property manager is not reported by you.

MISC_OTHER_THRESHOLD.title: 1099-MISC other income $2,000 threshold
MISC_OTHER_THRESHOLD.text: Other income payments of $2,000 or more in TY2026 are reported on Form 1099-MISC, box 3.

MISC_ROYALTY_THRESHOLD.title: 1099-MISC royalties $10 threshold
MISC_ROYALTY_THRESHOLD.text: Royalties of $10 or more are reported on Form 1099-MISC, box 2. This threshold did not change.

MISC_ATTORNEY_PROCEEDS.title: Gross proceeds paid to an attorney
MISC_ATTORNEY_PROCEEDS.text: Gross proceeds paid to an attorney (e.g., a settlement paid through the attorney) are reported on Form 1099-MISC, box 10, even if the attorney is a corporation. The TY2026 threshold for this box is pending confirmation; we flag conservatively at $600.

ATTORNEY_FEES.title: Attorney fees: corporation exemption does not apply
ATTORNEY_FEES.text: Fees for legal services of $2,000 or more are reported on Form 1099-NEC, box 1, even when the law firm is a corporation.

CORP_EXEMPT.title: Payments to corporations are generally exempt
CORP_EXEMPT.text: Payments to a C or S corporation (including an LLC that elected corporate taxation) generally do not need a 1099-NEC/MISC. Exceptions include attorney fees, gross proceeds paid to attorneys, and medical/health care payments.

CARD_APP_EXCLUDED.title: Card and payment-app payments go on Form 1099-K
CARD_APP_EXCLUDED.text: Payments you made by credit card, debit card, gift card, or through a third-party settlement organization (e.g., PayPal, Venmo business, Square, Stripe) are reported by the processor on Form 1099-K, so you exclude them from 1099-NEC/MISC. Zelle and ordinary bank transfers are NOT excluded.

GOODS_EXCLUDED.title: Payments for merchandise are not reported
GOODS_EXCLUDED.text: Payments for merchandise, inventory, freight, storage, telephone and similar items are not reported on Form 1099-NEC/MISC.

OUT_OF_YEAR.title: Only payments made in calendar year 2026 count
OUT_OF_YEAR.text: 1099 reporting uses the calendar year in which you made the payment. Payments dated outside 2026 were left out.

EXCLUDED_BY_USER.title: Not a reportable payee
EXCLUDED_BY_USER.text: You marked this payee as not a reportable payment (e.g., a transfer between your own accounts, payroll, taxes, or personal spending).

NEEDS_CATEGORY.title: Payment type not tagged yet
NEEDS_CATEGORY.text: Tag what these payments were for. Until then we assume services (the conservative choice).

CORP_UNKNOWN.title: Entity type unknown
CORP_UNKNOWN.text: We don't know whether this payee is a corporation, so we assume it is not (conservative). A W-9 tells you the payee's tax classification.

BACKUP_WITHHOLDING.title: Backup withholding (24%)
BACKUP_WITHHOLDING.text: If a payee is reportable and has not given you a correct TIN (e.g., via Form W-9), you must withhold 24% from future payments and report it on Form 945.

COLLECT_W9.title: Collect a W-9 now
COLLECT_W9.text: This payee is under the threshold so far, but has no TIN on file. Collect a W-9 before paying more: once total payments reach the threshold you will need the TIN, and backup withholding applies to a reportable payee with no TIN.

NEAR_THRESHOLD.title: Close to the threshold
NEAR_THRESHOLD.text: Total payments are within 10% of the threshold. Make sure every account and export is included before deciding not to file.

STATE_LOWER_THRESHOLD.title: State filing may be required
STATE_LOWER_THRESHOLD.text: Your state's 1099 rules may differ from the federal $2,000 threshold. See the state row for details.

deadlines.note: Jan 31, 2027 is a Sunday, so the deadline moves to Monday, Feb 1.

deadlines.note: Feb 16, 2027 if you report amounts in box 8 or 10.

deadlines.label: 1099-MISC recipient copies with box 8 or 10 amounts
deadlines.note: Feb 15, 2027 is Presidents' Day (a federal holiday).
